title: OpenRoleRadar Company
description: Employer record aggregated from one or more first-party career sources.

company_id.description: Stable identifier derived from canonical domain.

name.description: Display name as observed on careers pages.

normalized_name.description: Lowercase slug used for search and deduplication.

canonical_domain.description: Primary corporate domain (no scheme, no path).

aliases.description: Alternate names or brands associated with this employer.

ats_sources.description: ATS adapters observed for this company.

active_job_count.description: Number of open or reopened roles at last export.

historical_job_count.description: Total roles ever tracked for this company.
